limitations: CMD52 counts were zero after each reset; no postboot CMD52 performance qualification is claimed.
The two idle phases lost 1/69 and 3/69 replies; all workload phases had zero loss. Idle RTT spikes are retained and not attributed to the controller.
The first firmware has transfer-stage rows only; the second adds Wi-Fi wait rows. Neither has final native-SD wait breakdowns.
Driver hold timing excludes ownership-to-driver-entry and counter/unlock edges, so it does not bound total ownership duration.
The largest Wi-Fi waits were mostly before ownership grant with initial owner PID 8 (shell); that identifies an ownership interval, not proof of slow SD wire transfer.

The final native-SD image booted and loaded the dictionary, but its workload stopped at the Wi-Fi prerequisite. Later offline measurement could not start because USB serial disappeared again. Restoration of original OTA0 remains pending.
Instrumentation overhead is not calibrated. This measures one board/card and does not qualify write performance, power loss, boot speed or a latency improvement.
Raw serial transcripts may contain network identity; only their hashes and sanitized reports are published.
